Introduction

Chaehyun is a South Korean singer and dancer currently signed to WAKEONE. She is best known as the winner of the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999, which led to her becoming a member of the project girl group Kep1er.

Chaehyun made her official debut as a member of Kep1er on January 3, 2022, with the mini album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The debut received positive reception both in South Korea and internationally, further solidifying her place in the global kpop scene.

Prior to joining Girls Planet 999, Chaehyun was a trainee under SM Entertainment for approximately six years. She joined the company during her second year of middle school, abandoning her public school education to focus on her training. However, Chaehyun left the company between 2019 and 2020, seeking new opportunities and continuing her pursuit of a career in music.

In July 2021, Chaehyun participated in Girls Planet 999 as a member of K-Group. Her departure from SM Entertainment was discussed during the show's first episode, where she expressed her desire to prove that her six years of training had not been in vain. She initially ranked 23rd in K-Group and later secured a position in the Planet Top 9. By the show's finale on October 22, 2021, Chaehyun earned first place, amassing 1,081,182 points and 363,623 votes, securing her spot in the final lineup of Kep1er.

In January 2022, Chaehyun expanded her role by being announced as one of the hosts of SBS MTV's The Show, marking her debut as an MC alongside her music career.
